notes.title: Version 1.11.9 Fixes
notes.content:
* Reset the position of the skulls when the level is reset.
* Change the appearance of the skulls.
* Fix a bug where the achievements "Oof", "Tryharder" and "Eternal gratitude" didn't unlock.
* Fix a bug where the respawn was done at the wrong checkpoint in very specific cases.
* Fix a graphic bug that made the game blurry on Linux.

notes.title: Version 1.11.4 Hotfixes
notes.content:
* Fix a bug that prevented finishing the level a second time after finishing it once.
* Deactivate run in background.
* Delete an unintentionnal shortcut.
